_comment: The identities the Qwen lane is pinned to, each recorded with the source commit it was built from rather than on its own. A digest alone cannot prove parity with the code it is supposed to describe — the first gateway image was built ten minutes before the transport was corrected and nothing could tell. Nothing here attests the loaded runtime: that is Stage 3's job, from the GPU, and until it happens the output budgets remain candidate measurements and qwen_overlay stays off.

model.commit_marker: COMMITTED.json written last, after every artifact and the manifest
model.layout: v2 (manifest.json INSIDE artifacts/, staged and committed 2026-08-18). This prefix is what the endpoint mounts.
model.note: The v1 prefix stays valid and committed. v2 exists because a committed prefix is immutable: its marker means what it describes is final.
model.declared_architecture_note: Read from the staged artifacts/config.json on 2026-08-18. The image build requires this exact string from vLLM's ModelRegistry. It is a literal in base-stack.yaml rather than derived, because BuildImageRole deliberately has no model-bucket access — so a model revision that changed the architecture would have to be noticed here. config.json also carries vision_config, image_token_id and video_token_id: the checkpoint is the hybrid one, which is why serve.py passes language_model_only=True.
model.why_v2: v1 put manifest.json beside artifacts/ rather than inside it, and SageMaker mounts only what is under the prefix it is given — so no single MODEL_PATH could hold both the manifest and the weights. Mounting the v1 root left vLLM with no config.json and the engine never loaded; mounting v1/artifacts/ loaded but reported no model_id or model_revision, which attest.sh refuses as an incomplete runtime block. Both failures land on a billing GPU. A committed prefix is immutable by construction, so this is a new prefix rather than an edit; v1 stays valid and reconciled.

serving_image.why: 0.27.0's release notes add Qwen3.5 text-only dense and MoE models; 0.11.0 does not list the architecture and was withdrawn. The wheel is pinned by URL because PyPI cannot host a local version (PEP 440), and by sha256 because a URL names a location rather than an artifact — the hash was read back from GitHub's own asset digest. Note the +cu129 label buys reproducibility, not CUDA: vLLM's default PyPI wheel for this release is already a CUDA 12.9 build.
serving_image.reported_version: The image will report 0.27.1+cu129 — serve.py reads vllm.__version__ and never VLLM_VERSION. That string is hashed into tokenizer_runtime_manifest_sha256, so it must be settled before the contract is pinned and cannot change afterwards without re-attesting.
gates_before_push: vllm.__version__ starts with the declared version

superseded.why: vllm==0.11.0. Kept as history. Not to be deployed.

not_yet_true: No GPU endpoint exists and nothing is running. Quota L-B0729CB4 is now 2 for ml.g6e.xlarge endpoint usage (the case was granted; read back from Service Quotas 2026-08-18), so the quota is no longer what blocks a pass.
The serving image is pinned but not built: no CodeBuild run has produced a digest under the 0.27.1 pin, so serving_image_digest is still unmeasured.

attested is false, correctly: serving_image_digest and tokenizer_sha256 have no contract expectation yet, both being placeholders until a GPU measures them. They are reported as unattested rather than passed over.
The Step 5 bridge is built and untested against a real endpoint.
qwen_overlay is off and no invocation has ever been recorded.

gateway_image.verified: Two gates ran inside the image before it was pushed: every module imports as laid out, and gateway_revision recomputed from the image's own files equals the contract the image carries. After deploy, matches.gateway_revision is true.

superseded.why: Built from a flattened image layout, which gateway_revision could only handle because the checker tried two candidate roots — a checker that agrees with two trees. And nothing verified the image before it was pushed.

gateway_image.layout: The repository's paths, preserved. The checker has one layout, not two.
gateway_image.note: `gateway_revision_in_tree` is the current source; the deployed image predates this commit's gateway changes and must be rebuilt before it is attested again.

_status: **Describes what is deployed and staged now, not what a past step produced.** The serving image and the v2 artifact prefix below are NOT built or staged yet: the vLLM pin was withdrawn because 0.11.0 is unverified against Qwen3.5, and the staging job's v2 layout has not run. Recorded as pending rather than as a digest, because a pinned identity that names nothing is worse than an absent one.
